name: force-bed-mesh-adaptive
title: Force Adaptive Bed Mesh
author: bespoked
description: Forces an adaptive bed mesh before every print: it probes only the part of the bed your model uses, so leveling is faster while still accurate where it matters. It overrides a slicer that asks for a full mesh, and tells you when a file carries no object outline and the whole bed has to be probed. Pick this OR Force Bed Mesh, not both. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Mesh just the area your model covers, before each print.
